full_judgment: 3. The pre-emptee petitioner filed written objection denying the material allegations and contending that Plot No.221 pertaining to S.A. Khatian No.3 contained 1.63 acres of land out of which the respondent No.2 erected a house therein and while he had been in possession of the same new D.P. Khatian No.138 and new S.A. Dag No.408 was prepared and the above new BP Khatian having been prepared in the name of all the purchasers including the pre-emptor, there was no relation between the old Khatian and the new DP Khatian and further as the respondent No. 1 and other contiguous land owners, inspite of offer, were not interested in purchasing the case land, which was a low land and so the respondent No.2 decided to sell the same to the pre-emptee/petitioner, the contiguous land owner, at a consideration of Tk. 99,000/-and negotiation for sale was made with her husband and then a bainanama was executed between her and the respondent No. 2 on 16.2.1998 wherein along with others, the pre-emptor respondent No.1 also put their signature and subsequently, to decrease the registration cost, the sale deed was executed and registered on 15.4.1998 showing consideration of Tk. 20,000/-only and thereafter, the pre-emptee petitioner spent about Tk. 1,10,000/- for the development and filling of earth in the case land and also as spent Tk. 70,000/- for construction of the boundary wall and iron gate and besides pre-emptee also planted valuable trees in the case land spending about Tk. 30,000/- .Moreover the pre-emptor has no necessity of the case land and it is only because the case land became very valuable having fallen within the municipality area and the valuation of the land has thus increased to a great extent and now valuation of the suit land is about Tk.5,00,000/-, the pre-emptor filed the instant case.
